stories.title: Westbrook residents work to 'Stuff-A-Bus' with cash and food for families in need
stories.summary: The annual fundraiser filled two buses with food and have gathered $1,300 so far to support families who rely on school lunches over the vacation seasons.

stories.title: Washington County deputies request help in car theft investigation
stories.summary: The sheriff's office is looking for the owner of a black Chevy Silverado that was found to be stolen.

stories.title: Young bald eagle in Ogunquit receives care for lead poisoning
stories.summary: A juvenile bald eagle, beloved by Ogunquit residents, is in intensive care for lead poisoning. Officals say they hope the bird can return to the area soon.

stories.title: Portland man arrested in New Hampshire after police chase
stories.summary: A man from Portland was arrested by New Hampshire State Police after he was located by a K-9 during a police pursuit.

stories.title: The Old Town Grinch hands out candy canes and collects food for neighbors in need
stories.summary: Justin Russell, known as the Old Town Grinch, is greeting shoppers at the Bangor Craft Fair and leading a food drive that challenges the community to out-give him.

stories.title: Four Maine state elections scheduled for recount
stories.summary: The Secretary of State's Office's schedule shows recounts will take place this week.

stories.title: Bangor convenience store employee assaulted during reported robbery
stories.summary: A woman has been arrested and charged in connection with an alleged robbery and assault on Sunday.

stories.title: Raymond crash leaves 1 with life-threatening injuries
stories.summary: The passenger was taken by LifeFlight to a hospital, according to deputies. Another was injured with non-life-threatening injuries.

stories.title: Six months since Searsmont: Maine firefighters reflect
stories.summary: The deadly explosion killed three people and injured 10 others, becoming one of the state's worst firefighting disasters.

stories.title: Burnouts at Lisbon memorial prompt police response
stories.summary: About 20 vehicles gathered near Ridge Road on Saturday for a memorial honoring a woman's late husband. Police said no tickets were issued.

stories.title: Pickup truck catches fire on Portland's Park Avenue
stories.summary: Portland firefighters quickly put out a pickup truck fire near the intersection of Park and Deering avenues Friday evening. No injuries were reported.
